name: safe-shell-skill
description: Quote one or an ordered batch of dynamic shell arguments through structured MCP tools or a CLI fallback.

interface.longDescription: Generate shell-specific source fragments for one or an ordered batch of literal data arguments through persistent structured MCP tools, with CLI fallback for bash, zsh, fish, sh, dash, ksh, PowerShell, pwsh, CMD, and MSYS2.
defaultPrompt: Quote this dynamic argument for the shell command I am composing.
Quote these ordered dynamic arguments while preserving their boundaries.
Check whether this value can be represented as one CMD argument.
